title: Hiring: 2 Video Editor
description:
2 Positions Available | Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term



We are looking for 2 more Video Editors who can create videos similar to the sample/reference videos we will provide.



Please only apply if you are confident in your editing skills, can follow instructions, and can commit to the role.



We are not looking for people who simply claim to be experts. Even if you don't have years of experience, that's okay. What matters to us is that you can deliver quality work, follow instructions, communicate well, and consistently meet deadlines.



COMPENSATION



$700/month fixed rate (non-negotiable)

Paid bi-weekly every 15th and 30th via Wise.



WORK & DELIVERABLES

- 2–3 motion graphic videos per day (Some days will require 2 videos, while other days will require 3 videos)

- All daily deliverables must be completed before 11:00 PM PHT

- You must submit each video as soon as it is finished so we can review it and request revisions if needed

- Briefs and references will be provided

- You must be able to follow our references, instructions, and editing style

- You should also be creative and able to make good editing decisions based on the brief



You should understand:

- Pacing

- Hooks

- Text placement

- Transitions

- Visual effects

- Timing and flow

- Overall visual consistency



SCHEDULE

- Monday–Friday

- There is NO time tracking. (You have the flexibility to manage your own working hours as long as you:

Complete 2–3 videos per day

Consistently meet the daily deadline

Submit videos as soon as they are finished for review

Handle revisions promptly when needed



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who:

- Has strong video editing skills

- Can create high-quality motion graphic videos

- Can follow references and instructions accurately

- Can adapt to different editing styles

- Has a strong work ethic

- Can work independently

- Is reliable and communicative

- Can consistently meet deadlines

- Is willing to commit to a long-term working relationship



If you already have editing samples, that's a plus.



You don't need to have many years of experience. If you can deliver the quality we need and can commit to the role, we want to hear from you.



PROBATION & LONG-TERM WORK

- The first 2 weeks will be a probation period

- During this period, we will evaluate your work quality, reliability, communication, ability to follow instructions, and overall performance

- If you meet our expectations, we will continue with a long-term working relationship

- We are looking for someone who wants stable, long-term work and wants to grow with our team



WHAT WE OFFER

- $700/month fixed rate

- Paid bi-weekly via Wise

- Long-term job stability

- Consistent work with our team

- Flexible working hours

- No time tracker

- Opportunity to grow with the team

- Long-term working relationship after successful 2week probation



HOW TO APPLY

Required Subject: [Your Name] - Motion Graphics Video Editor



Please include:

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your portfolio link

Confirmation that you:

-Can adapt to different editing styles

-Can complete a trial task immediately

-Can commit to Monday–Friday

-Can complete 2–3 motion graphic videos per day

-Can communicate and respond consistently

-Can start ASAP



Answer this question:

Why should we hire you? (Please keep your answer to one short paragraph.)



FINAL NOTE

We take every applicant seriously, so please only apply if you are confident in your skills, agree with everything listed above, and are ready to commit.



The final step of our onboarding process is a short trial task. If your trial meets our expectations, we can move forward with onboarding immediately.



Apply today → Complete the trial task → Get onboarded.



No long process.



If you're confident in your video editing skills, can create high-quality work, have a strong work ethic, can work independently, follow instructions, and consistently meet deadlines, we want to connect with you.

We are looking for a highly proactive Creator Partnerships & Ambassador Manager who can take ownership of finding, recruiting and managing influencers, content creators and brand ambassadors across multiple countries.

, Instagram/TikTok DMs and other relevant channels

title: Short-Form Instagram Video Editor (Fitness Personal Brand)
description:
# Short-Form Instagram Video Editor — Fitness Personal Brand



**Type:** Part-Time / Freelance

**Starting Workload:** 20–25 Instagram Reels per month

**Potential Workload:** 25–30+ Reels per month

**Starting Rate:** $10–$12 USD per completed Reel

**Long-Term Opportunity:** Yes



Example Reels I'm Looking To Create ↓ 


 











## About The Role



I run an online fitness coaching business focused on helping men get leaner, build structure, stay consistent, and get below 15% body fat.



I'm looking for a reliable short-form video editor who can help me consistently publish **simple, clean, high-quality Instagram Reels**.



This is NOT a role for someone who needs to create complicated animations, cinematic edits, or spend hours editing one video.



The editing style I'm looking for is:



**Minimal. Clean. Fast-paced. Easy to consume.**



I will handle the:



* Content ideas

* Hooks

* Scripts/talking points

* Filming

* Raw footage

* Offers

* CTAs

* Content strategy



Your primary responsibility is **post-production**.



I want to hand you the raw footage and receive a finished Reel that is ready to post.



---



## Content You Will Be Editing



The content will primarily revolve around men's fitness, fat loss, body composition, discipline, mindset, and consistency.



Examples include:



* How to get abs

* How to get lean

* How to get below 15% body fat

* How to reach 12% body fat

* Best and worst foods for fat loss

* Fitness tier-list videos

* High-protein food rankings

* Exercise rankings

* Fat-loss mistakes

* Why you're not losing weight

* Habits keeping men overweight

* How to structure your diet

* How to stay consistent

* Building discipline

* Building routines and structure

* Mindset around fitness

* Talking-head fitness advice



Some videos will be educational.



Some will be opinion/ranking-style content designed to generate comments.



Some will have a simple CTA at the end asking viewers to comment a keyword to receive something through ManyChat.



For example:



**"Comment LEAN and I'll send you the guide."**



The CTA will already be provided to you.



You are **not responsible for creating the marketing strategy or managing ManyChat.**



---



## Editing Style



Most videos should be relatively simple.



Typical editing may include:



* Removing mistakes and dead space

* Jump cuts

* Cleaning up pacing

* Basic audio cleanup

* Clean captions/subtitles

* Highlighting important words (If needed)

* Occasional punch-ins / zooms

* B-roll where it improves the point

* Images appearing on screen

* Screenshots appearing on screen

* Food images

* Exercise footage

* Before-and-after examples when provided

* Tier-list graphics

* Simple text graphics

* Light sound effects

* Background music when appropriate

* Clear CTA text at the end

* Proper 9:16 Instagram formatting



I do NOT want every second filled with animations (Unless needed)



The goal is to make the content **easy to watch without making the editing distracting.**



The idea, hook, and message should remain the focus.



---



## Example Editing Philosophy



If I'm talking about:



**"The 5 best foods for getting below 15% body fat"**



I may already provide the talking-head footage.



Your job might simply be to:



1. Cut out pauses and mistakes.

2. Add clean captions.

3. Display each food as I mention it.

4. Add an image of the food.

5. Add light zooms/punch-ins where appropriate.

6. Add simple sound effects if necessary.

7. Show the CTA clearly at the end.



That's it.



I value **good judgment and restraint**.



More editing does not automatically mean better editing.



---



# Content Funnel



You should understand that most of this content will be **top-of-funnel and middle-of-funnel content**.



The objective is to:



**Get attention → provide value → create engagement → generate comments → move interested viewers into my fitness coaching funnel.**



You will NOT be expected to develop this strategy.



However, understanding the purpose of the content will help you make better editing decisions.



The Reel needs to keep attention without distracting from the message or CTA.



---



## Expected Volume



### Phase 1 — First 90 Days



We will initially produce approximately:



**5–7 Reels per week**



However, the starting monthly commitment will generally be around:



**20–25 Reels per month.**



If we work well together and the content produces results, the workload can increase toward:



**25–30+ Reels per month.**



I'm looking for someone interested in consistent, recurring work rather than random one-off projects.



---



## Compensation



Starting compensation is:



**$12–$15 USD per completed Reel.**



Most videos will be simple talking-head edits.



Videos requiring substantially more editing, graphics, B-roll, or custom work may be compensated differently when agreed upon beforehand.



The initial relationship will begin with a **paid test edit**.



If the quality, communication, turnaround time, and reliability are strong, I want to develop this into a long-term working relationship.



As the business grows and responsibilities increase, compensation can increase as well.



---



## Turnaround Time



Standard turnaround should generally be:



**24–48 hours.**



Footage will often be delivered in batches so you can work efficiently.



Reliability is extremely important.



I don't want to chase someone every week asking when videos will be finished.



---



## Revisions



Most videos should require minimal revisions once you understand the editing style.



Initially, there may be more feedback while we establish the system.



You should be comfortable receiving direct feedback and making reasonable revisions.



The goal is eventually to develop a repeatable editing system where you already know how I want the content edited.



---



# Ideal Candidate



You are a strong fit if you:



* Have experience editing Instagram Reels

* Have experience with talking-head content

* Understand short-form pacing

* Understand captions and subtitle placement

* Know when to use B-roll and when NOT to use it

* Can find simple images/B-roll when necessary

* Understand fitness content

* Can follow reference videos closely

* Communicate clearly

* Deliver work consistently

* Follow deadlines

* Respond well to feedback

* Pay attention to details

* Want ongoing work

* Can maintain the same editing style across dozens of videos



You do NOT need to be an advanced motion graphics editor.



I care much more about:



**Reliability + Speed + Taste + Following Instructions**



than complicated editing.



---



# Software



Preferred:



* CapCut Desktop / CapCut Pro

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve



Other professional editing software is acceptable.



---



# Paid Test



Before selecting the long-term editor, I will hire a few candidates for a small paid test.



Everyone will receive similar raw footage and instructions.



The test will primarily evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Pacing

* Captions

* Visual choices

* Ability to follow instructions

* Communication

* Turnaround time



This is a **paid test**, not free spec work.



---



# How To Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your name

2. Your location

3. Your primary editing software

4. How long you've been editing short-form content

5. Links to your **3 best short-form videos**

6. Examples of talking-head content you've edited

7. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–90 second Reel

8. How many Reels you could reliably edit each week

9. Whether you're comfortable working at the starting rate of **$10–$12 per Reel**

10. Why you're interested in consistent long-term work



Then answer this question:



**If someone is talking to the camera for 60 seconds, what would you do to keep the video interesting without over-editing it?**



At the very top of your application, write:



**COMEBACK**



If you do not include **COMEBACK** at the beginning of your application, I will assume you did not read the full posting.



I'm looking for an editor I can build a long-term system with as the brand and business grow.

* Have previous experience working in an internal recruitment, agency recruitment or talent acquisition role

* Have experience of working with recruitment pipelines and ATS systems

* Have strong sourcing skills and experience using job boards and LinkedIn to identify candidates

* Have excellent communication and customer service skills

This role is primarily focused on creating high-quality videos for platforms including Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You'll work from clear briefs and reference examples to produce content that captures attention, retains viewers, and delivers a professional finish.

Add motion graphics and visual effects

Communicate progress and timelines effectively

Apply best practices for viewer engagement and retention

Stay up to date with current editing styles and social media trends

Continuously look for ways to improve content quality and performance



Essential Skills & Experience

Proven experience editing short-form social media content

Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention

title: Advanced TikTok Shop Short-Form Video Editor – Retention, Pacing & Sound Design
description:
We are a Germany-based TikTok Shop affiliate creator business currently generating around €70,000 in monthly revenue and looking to grow.



We are looking for an advanced TikTok Shop short-form video editor for a long-term position.



This role starts at 20 hours/week. Strong performers may have the opportunity to increase to 40 hours/week in the future while keeping the same hourly compensation structure.



Your main focus will be editing TikTok Shop videos for maximum viewer retention, pacing, engagement and overall video quality.



You do NOT need to write scripts, hooks or CTAs. Concepts, structure, raw footage and reference TikTok Shop videos will be provided.



What matters most:

- Excellent TikTok Shop / short-form pacing and retention editing

- Making the first seconds visually engaging and attention-grabbing

- Removing dead time and choosing the strongest takes

- Clean cuts, punch-ins, zooms, movement and pattern interrupts

- Knowing how to use visual changes to keep viewers watching

- Keeping TikTok Shop videos fast-paced and native to the platform without over-editing

- Following references and instructions very accurately

- Strong sound editing is a major plus: sound effects, audio timing, clean voice/audio processing and using sound to make TikTok Shop videos feel more dynamic and engaging



You will often receive longer recordings containing multiple takes and camera angles. Your job is to identify the strongest usable takes, cut them into clean segments and edit them according to our provided TikTok Shop style and references.



Compensation & Benefits:

- 20 hours/week

- €500/month base salary

- Up to €100/month performance bonus

- Higher compensation available for exceptional candidates

- Weekly payments during the first weeks

- 13th-month pay in accordance with Philippine law

- Paid 2-month probationary period

- Long-term position

- Opportunity to increase to 40 hours/week for strong performers



To apply, please attach your CV/resume and briefly answer:



1. What TikTok Shop or short-form editing experience do you have that would help you perform well in this role?

2. Where have you worked before, what were your main responsibilities, and what relevant experience or skills did you gain from those roles?

3. Please send 3–5 of your best short-form editing examples. Examples with strong pacing, retention and sound design are especially useful.

4. What editing software do you use?

5. Are you currently employed or working for other clients?

6. Are you fully available for 20 hours/week?

7. If this role grows to 40 hours/week, would you be interested and available? How much notice would you need?

8. How reliable are your internet connection and electricity? How often do outages happen, how long do they usually last, and what backup options do you have?

9. What do you genuinely enjoy doing outside of work?

10. Are you comfortable with the stated compensation? If your expected compensation is higher, please state it briefly.



Top candidates will complete a short paid TikTok Shop editing test using real footage from our workflow.

This is a broad, high-trust role for someone who can become a true extension of the founders — understanding priorities, anticipating what needs to happen next, and actively looking for ways to make their lives easier. The ideal candidate is comfortable receiving voice notes and imperfect instructions, then turning them into clear actions without requiring constant management.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time, with a clear path to full-time

Location: Remote

Timezone: UKT / EST (flex — founders travel frequently across time zones)

Compensation: 7 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Executive & Personal Support

Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, dinners, and events

Plan and book domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, transport, and itineraries

Handle personal and professional bookings, purchases, reservations, and ad hoc requests

Organise and send gifts for birthdays, client milestones, personal occasions, and professional relationships

Maintain reminders for important dates, commitments, and follow-ups

Proactively recommend actions based on upcoming events, travel, workload, and personal priorities

Help keep the founders organised across both professional and personal responsibilities



Finance & Administrative Support

Prepare and send customer invoices and follow up on outstanding administrative items

Support bill payments, expense management, and basic finance administration

Maintain cash balance trackers and other internal finance spreadsheets

Review statements and ensure transactions and financial records are correctly logged

Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, suppliers, and other finance partners where required

Maintain organised digital files, receipts, invoices, and business documentation

Support recurring data entry across campaigns, reporting, and internal systems

Note: This role involves access to highly sensitive financial and business information — exceptional discretion, judgment, and trustworthiness are essential



Founder Support & Proactive Task Management

Translate voice notes,
s, and informal requests into clear tasks and actions

Manage multiple tasks from a single brief without requiring every step to be explained

Follow up proactively when decisions, approvals, or information are outstanding

Maintain visibility of open tasks and ensure commitments don't fall through the cracks

Identify recurring or low-value tasks that can be removed from the founders' plates

Gradually build a deep understanding of the business, the founders' working styles, and their personal preferences

Proactively look for opportunities to take on work — rather than waiting to be asked



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ EA Agency / Executive Support Organisation Background Strongly Preferred: Candidates with experience working within a professional EA staffing or executive support organisation will be prioritised — please highlight this in your application

EA Experience: 3+ years supporting founders, CEOs, executives, or senior leaders in a high-trust Executive Assistant role

Calendar & Travel Management: Strong experience managing complex calendars, travel itineraries, and scheduling across time zones

Finance Administration: Comfortable handling invoices, expenses, payments, and basic financial administration including spreadsheet tracking

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders

Technical Skills: Strong Google Workspace and spreadsheet skills; comfortable working across digital tools and systems

Working Style: Able to prioritise independently, make sensible judgment calls, and work from voice notes or fast-moving, incomplete instructions

Discretion: Highly discreet when handling sensitive personal, financial, and business information

Profile: Proactive, resourceful, and confident taking ownership of tasks from beginning to end; adapts quickly in a fast-moving environment



Nice to Have

title: Fitness Coaching Brand Short-Form Video Editor (Instagram Reels + TikTok)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — Fitness Coaching Brand (Instagram Reels + TikTok)



Fitness/mindset editing experience required.



Type: Part-time / Freelance, ongoing

Volume: 10–20 Reels per month to start, scaling to 30+

Rate: $12–$15 per finished Reel (paid test first, rate review after 90 days)

Turnaround: 24–48 hours



Read This First



This role is only for editors who already edit fitness, fat-loss, or mindset content. If your portfolio doesn't include fitness or mindset short-form videos, please don't apply. I won't review general portfolios.



About Me



I run a 1:1 online coaching business helping men 25–45 get lean, build structure, stay consistent, and get below 15% body fat.



I handle ideas, hooks, scripts, filming, offers, CTAs, and strategy. You handle post-production. I send raw footage, and you send back a Reel that's ready to post.



Reference Reels




/p/Dci1UH0pxS-/


/p/Dcla12IB-mq/


/p/Dao4_e1gREE/


/p/Dcb9bS0ymHP/


/p/DdeTmb5o11a/



What You'll Edit

Talking-head fitness advice. This is the majority of the work.

Rankings and tier lists. Examples: best and worst foods for fat loss, high-protein foods, exercise rankings.

Educational breakdowns. Examples: how to get to 12% body fat, why you're not losing weight, fat-loss mistakes.

Discipline, consistency, and mindset content.

ManyChat CTA endings. Example: "Comment LEAN and I'll send you the guide." I provide the CTA. Your job is to make it clear on screen.



Most of this is top- and middle-of-funnel content. Every edit has one job: hold attention and drive comments without pulling focus from the message.



The Style



Minimal. Clean. Fast. Easy to watch.



Your toolkit:



Jump cuts and dead-space removal

Clean captions with key words highlighted

Occasional punch-ins

Basic audio cleanup

On-screen food images, exercise clips, and screenshots

Simple tier-list graphics

Light sound effects and music

A clear CTA at the end

9:16 formatting



What I don't want is animation in every second, cinematic effects, or anything that competes with what I'm saying. Restraint is a skill here. More editing isn't better editing.



Example: For "5 foods that get you below 15% body fat," a great edit means:



Cut the pauses and mistakes.

Add clean captions.

Show each food on screen as I name it.

Add a punch-in or two.

Add light sound effects if needed.

End with a clean CTA.



That's it.



You're a Fit If You

Have edited fitness or mindset Reels/TikToks for a creator or coach. This is required.

Know fitness well enough to pull the right B-roll without being told. You know what a Romanian deadlift looks like versus a good morning, and why a tier list needs to be readable at a glance.

Understand short-form pacing. That includes caption placement and when B-roll helps versus distracts.

Can match reference videos. You can keep one consistent style across dozens of edits.

Hit deadlines without being chased. You also take direct feedback well.

Want recurring long-term work. This isn't a one-off gig.



You don't need motion graphics skills. I care about reliability, speed, taste, and following instructions.



Software: CapCut Desktop/Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent.



Paid Test



Shortlisted candidates get the same raw footage and brief, paid at the standard per-Reel rate. I'm judging:



Pacing

Captions

Visual choices

How well you follow instructions

Communication

Turnaround time

How to Apply



Start your application with the word COMEBACK. If it's not at the top, I'll assume you didn't read the posting.



Name and location (include your time zone)

Primary editing software

How long you've edited short-form content, and how much of that has been fitness or mindset

Links to 3 fitness or mindset Reels/TikToks you've edited, with your role in each

At least one talking-head edit

Typical turnaround for a 30–90 second Reel

How many Reels you can reliably deliver per week

Confirmation that you're comfortable at $12–$15 per Reel



Then answer these briefly:



Someone talks to the camera for 60 seconds. What do you do to keep it interesting without over-editing?

Pick one of my reference Reels. What's one editing choice that works, and one thing you'd change?

Name two fitness creators whose editing you'd study for this role, and say what they do well.

Optional: do you train or follow fitness content yourself?

title: CEO MUM Podcast Content & Social Media Distribution Manager  Remote | Freelance / Part-Time | Ongoing
description:
CEO MUM is looking for a highly organised Podcast Content & Social Media Distribution Manager to manage the publishing and distribution of our podcast content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts and Spotify.



This is not primarily a video-editing role. Our podcast editor will provide the finished long-form episode, mastered audio, trailer and approximately 10–20 finished short-form clips.



Your job is to take those finished assets and make sure they are correctly packaged, scheduled, published and optimised across every platform.



We are looking for someone who understands social media and podcast distribution, is highly organised, has excellent attention to detail and can manage the publishing workflow without needing constant supervision.



WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE



For each CEO MUM episode, you will receive:



* Finished long-form podcast video

* Finished/mastered podcast audio

* Episode trailer

* Approximately 10–20 finished vertical clips

* Transcript

* Guest information

* Suggested copy/captions and content direction

* Brand assets



AI-generated draft copy may also be provided, but you should be confident checking and formatting it appropriately for each platform.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Instagram



* Schedule and publish approximately 10–20 Reels from each podcast episode

* Schedule content across appropriate days/times rather than publishing everything together

* Add captions/copy

* Correctly tag guests and relevant accounts

* Add appropriate hashtags/keywords where useful

* Check formatting before publication

* Add Reel covers when required

* Ensure the CEO MUM Instagram grid/profile remains visually consistent



TikTok



* Upload and schedule the same short-form content to the CEO MUM TikTok account

* Adapt captions/copy appropriately for TikTok rather than blindly copying Instagram text

* Add relevant tags/keywords

* Select/upload covers when required

* Check every post before it goes live



YouTube Shorts



* Upload and schedule short-form clips as YouTube Shorts

* Add appropriate titles and descriptions

* Ensure clips are correctly formatted and organised



YouTube — full podcast



For every full episode:



* Upload the finished long-form video

* Create/add the episode title and description

* Add guest information and relevant links

* Add chapters/timestamps where supplied

* Add appropriate tags/metadata

* Schedule publication

* Add the supplied/custom YouTube thumbnail

* Check the episode after upload to ensure video, audio, description and thumbnail are correct



Bonus: ability to design professional YouTube podcast thumbnails that fit the CEO MUM visual identity.



Spotify / podcast distribution



* Upload the finished mastered podcast audio

* Add episode title, description and show information

* Add relevant episode artwork where required

* Schedule the episode

* Upload/publish the episode trailer where appropriate

* Check that episodes have distributed correctly



Experience with podcast hosting/distribution platforms is highly desirable.



CONTENT SCHEDULING



The goal is to turn each podcast episode into an organised stream of content rather than publishing everything at once.



There may be 10–20 social clips from a single episode, which should be scheduled across Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts according to an agreed content calendar.



You should be comfortable managing a scheduling tool and maintaining a clear publishing calendar so we can easily see:



what is going live → on which platform → on which day → at what time → for which podcast episode.



You should also be able to identify if content is missing, duplicated, incorrectly scheduled or hasn’t published successfully.



ATTENTION TO DETAIL



To show that you have read the full job description, include the word PUBLISH in the subject line of your application.



Applications without this word may not be reviewed.



COPY & AI



You do not need to be a professional copywriter.



We can provide transcripts, episode information and AI-generated draft captions/copy.



However, you must have excellent written English and be able to:



* Proofread copy

* Check names and 

* Correct obvious AI errors

* Format captions appropriately for each platform

* Make sure copy accurately represents what is said in the episode

* Never publish inaccurate or unverified information



Experience using ChatGPT or Claude as part of a content workflow is useful.



DESIGN — BONUS, NOT ESSENTIAL



Basic design skills would be helpful for:



* YouTube thumbnails

* Instagram Reel covers

* TikTok covers

* Simple podcast artwork

* Canva templates



Please tell us if you can do this and provide examples.



This is a bonus skill rather than a requirement. We would rather hire an excellent, reliable distribution manager and have design handled separately than compromise on organisation and accuracy.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should have experience with some or all of:



* Instagram content management

* TikTok content management

* YouTube / YouTube Studio

* YouTube Shorts

* Podcast publishing/distribution

* Spotify for Creators or podcast hosting platforms

* Meta Business Suite

* TikTok Studio

* Social-media scheduling tools

* Content calendars

* Canva

* Google Drive/Dropbox

* ChatGPT and/or Claude



You must be:



* Extremely organised

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable managing multiple platforms

* Fluent in written English

* Able to follow a publishing schedule

* Confident checking your own work

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to communicate quickly if there is a publishing problem



Experience with podcasts, women’s media, parenting, entrepreneurship or lifestyle brands is a bonus.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This is a remote freelance role.



The workload will depend on the CEO MUM podcast release schedule. Our upcoming season contains 10 episodes, and we expect approximately two episodes per month, although the exact schedule may vary.



There is potential for this to become an ongoing role beyond the season.



We are interested in someone who can become responsible for the CEO MUM publishing workflow long term.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction and where you’re based.

2. Examples of social-media accounts, podcasts or YouTube channels you have managed.

3. Which of these platforms you have personally published to: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts and Spotify/podcast platforms.

4. Which scheduling tools you have used.

5. Whether you have experience uploading and scheduling full podcast episodes.

6. Whether you can create YouTube thumbnails/Reel/TikTok covers. If yes, please send examples.

7. Your usual turnaround/availability.

8. Your proposed rate for managing the complete distribution of ONE podcast episode and its associated 10–20 social clips across the platforms above.

9. Whether you would offer a different rate for ongoing work across the full 10-episode season.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Fitness Education Channel)
description:
# Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Fitness Education Channel



**Type:** Part-Time / Freelance

**Starting Volume:** 1 YouTube video per week

**Typical Video Length:** 8–12 minutes

**Starting Pay:** $30–$40 USD per completed video

**Potential:** Long-term recurring work with increased pay and volume



## About The Role



I run an online fitness coaching and education brand focused on helping men get leaner, get below 15% body fat, build structure, become more consistent, and understand how to actually manage their fitness long term.



I'm looking for a reliable long-form YouTube editor who can take my recorded footage and turn it into a clean, professional, educational YouTube video.



This is primarily a **post-production role**.



I will handle:



* Video topics

* Research

* Scripts

* Talking points

* Recording

* Overall content strategy

* Offers and CTAs



Your job is to take the raw footage and script and turn them into a polished YouTube video that is ready to publish.



---



# The Content



Most videos will be educational fitness videos between approximately **8–12 minutes**.



Topics may include:



* How to get below 15% body fat

* How to reach 10–12% body fat

* How to lose fat without losing muscle

* Calories and macros

* Protein

* Foods for fat loss

* Training

* Cardio

* Fitness mistakes

* Why people regain weight

* Why men struggle with consistency

* Building discipline

* Creating structure

* Habit change

* Mindset

* Fitness case studies

* Client examples

* Breaking down common fitness myths



The videos will normally be scripted or highly structured.



You will receive the script along with the footage.



---



# Editing Style



I am NOT looking for extremely flashy or over-edited YouTube videos.



The priority is:



**Clear education + strong pacing + visual support + viewer retention.**



The editing should make the information easier to understand without distracting from the speaker.



Think:



**Professional fitness education rather than entertainment editing.**



Most videos will primarily be talking-head footage.



Your edits may include:



* Removing mistakes

* Removing dead space

* Removing unnecessary pauses

* Tightening pacing

* Cleaning audio

* Basic color correction

* Jump cuts

* Strategic punch-ins and zooms

* On-screen text

* Key-word highlighting

* B-roll

* Images

* Screenshots

* Fitness footage

* Food images

* Simple diagrams

* Simple charts

* Study screenshots

* Before-and-after examples when provided

* Basic animations

* Light sound effects

* Light background music when appropriate



You should understand that **more editing does not automatically mean better editing.**



The information is the product.



Your editing should help the viewer understand and stay engaged with that information.



---



# Example



If the video is:



**“How I Would Go From 20% Body Fat to 12% Body Fat”**



I may provide you with:



* The complete script

* Talking-head footage

* Supporting screenshots

* Studies or graphs

* Before-and-after images

* Specific visual examples



Your job would be to:



1. Tighten the talking-head footage.

2. Remove mistakes and unnecessary pauses.

3. Maintain strong pacing.

4. Add text when an important concept needs emphasis.

5. Insert relevant B-roll or images where appropriate.

6. Display graphs, examples, or screenshots when they're mentioned.

7. Use simple visual changes to prevent the video from becoming visually stagnant.

8. Clean the audio and color.

9. Deliver a finished 16:9 YouTube video ready to publish.



The video should feel professional without feeling overly produced.



---



# Purpose Of The Content



These videos will primarily be used as **educational middle-of-funnel content**.



The goal is not just to get random views.



The goal is to build:



**Attention → Education → Trust → Proof → Interest in coaching**



Someone should be able to watch one of these videos and think:



**“This guy clearly understands how to solve the problem I'm dealing with.”**



You are not responsible for creating the marketing strategy.



However, understanding the purpose of the content will help you make smarter editing decisions.



---



# Starting Workload



We will start with:



**1 long-form YouTube video per week.**



Approximately:



**4 videos per month.**



Typical finished runtime:



**8–12 minutes.**



If everything goes well, the amount of work may increase over time.



There may also eventually be opportunities to work on:



* Additional weekly YouTube videos

* Short-form content

* Video sales letters

* Client case studies

* Fitness educational series

* Other content for the brand



I'm looking for someone who wants **consistent long-term work**, not someone looking for one or two random projects.



---



# Compensation



Starting compensation will be approximately:



**$30–$40 USD per finished video.**



The final rate will depend on:



* Quality

* Experience

* Editing ability

* Turnaround time

* Communication

* Ability to follow the reference style



Videos requiring substantially more graphics, animations, or editing may be compensated differently when agreed upon beforehand.



This role will begin with a **paid test project**.



If you consistently deliver strong work and become easier to work with over time, compensation and workload can increase.



---



# What I'm Looking For



You should have experience editing long-form YouTube videos.



You should understand:



* Talking-head editing

* Educational content

* YouTube pacing

* Retention

* Story flow

* B-roll placement

* Text overlays

* Basic motion graphics

* Audio cleanup

* Color correction

* Visual storytelling



Most importantly, you should understand **when NOT to edit**.



I do not want random effects every three seconds.



The editing needs to support the information.



---



# Software



You may use:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut Desktop



I care more about the final product than which software you use.



---



# Turnaround Time



Target turnaround:



**2–4 days after receiving the footage.**



Communication matters.



If something is going to be late, communicate before the deadline.



I do not want to constantly follow up asking when a video will be completed.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



I'm deliberately starting this relationship small.



The first goal is simple:



**Prove that we work well together.**



If you consistently:



* Produce good work

* Follow instructions

* Meet deadlines

* Communicate clearly

* Learn the editing style

* Reduce the number of revisions

* Become easier to work with over time



then I want to continue increasing your responsibilities, workload, and compensation as the brand grows.



I'm looking for someone who could potentially become my **long-term YouTube editor**.



---



# Paid Test



Shortlisted applicants will receive a **paid test edit**.



You will receive:



* Raw footage

* Script

* Editing instructions

* Reference material



The test will evaluate:



* Pacing

* Editing judgment

* Visual choices

* Ability to follow instructions

* Communication

* Turnaround time

* Attention to detail



I do not expect free work.



---



# How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your name

2. Your location

3. Your primary editing software

4. How long you have been editing YouTube videos

5. Links to your **3 best long-form YouTube edits**

6. Examples of talking-head or educational videos you've edited

7. Your normal turnaround time for an 8–12 minute video

8. How many long-form videos you could realistically edit per week

9. Whether you're comfortable starting at $30–$40 per video

10. Why you're interested in building a long-term working relationship



Please do NOT send me only TikTok or Instagram examples.



I specifically want to see **long-form YouTube work**.



Finally, answer this question:



**How would you make a 10-minute talking-head educational video engaging without over-editing it?**



At the very beginning of your application, write:



**LONGFORM**



Applications without **LONGFORM** at the top will not be considered.

title: Long-Form YouTube Documentary Editor | AI Visuals + Sound Design
description:
We are building Earth Before Memory, a new English-language YouTube documentary channel focused on prehistoric Earth, extinct animals, ancient oceans, evolution and deep time.



We are looking for ONE long-term editor who can take a detailed production blueprint and turn it into a polished 12–16 minute cinematic documentary.



This is not a basic “cut clips together” editing job.



You should be comfortable handling most of the production process yourself, including:



• Long-form YouTube editing

• AI-generated images and video

• Cinematic still-image animation / parallax

• ElevenLabs voice generation and selecting the best takes

• Music selection

• Sound design

• Maps, diagrams and simple documentary UI

• Visual consistency across many shots

• Basic scientific / visual fact-checking

• Asset sourcing and licensing

• Final audio mix and export



STYLE



The channel should feel like a premium natural-history documentary.



Think:

• cinematic

• intelligent

• immersive

• scientifically believable

• strong pacing

• controlled tension



Do NOT apply if your work mainly looks like:

• generic AI slideshows

• TikTok / Shorts editing

• meme editing

• gaming videos

• excessive transitions or whooshes

• low-quality AI imagery

• basic stock-footage compilations



We already provide a detailed production system including:



• full script

• shot-by-shot edit plan

• pacing targets

• visual prompts

• narration settings

• music / sound direction

• fact-check notes

• brand rules

• quality-control checklist



You are not expected to invent the entire documentary from scratch.



Your job is to EXECUTE the production at a high level.



VOICE



Narration will use ElevenLabs.



You should be able to:

• generate multiple takes

• select the most natural take

• correct pronunciation problems

• maintain consistent pacing

• avoid robotic delivery

• edit narration cleanly



AI VISUALS



You must understand how to keep characters / objects visually consistent across many shots.



For example, one upcoming documentary uses the same small wooden sailboat throughout the entire video.



You must also be able to spot obvious AI problems such as:

• incorrect anatomy

• malformed animals

• unrealistic scale

• duplicated objects

• strange textures

• text artifacts

• inconsistent environments



PAID TEST



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid 75–90 second editing test.



Paid test: $35 USD.



The test includes the same type of production instructions you would receive for a full video.



Only the strongest candidates will move to ongoing production.



FULL VIDEO BUDGET



Initial budget:

$150–$200 USD per finished 12–16 minute documentary.



This can increase if you consistently deliver strong work and can handle the production independently.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship, not hiring for one video.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



BEFORE MEMORY



Applications without these words at the beginning will not be considered.



Then answer the following:



1. Send a maximum of 3 portfolio links.



For EACH link, give the exact 20–60 second timestamp you want us to watch.



2. Which piece in your portfolio is closest to cinematic documentary / natural-history YouTube editing, and why?



3. Which AI image and AI video tools have you personally used?



4. Have you worked with ElevenLabs? Explain how you handle multiple takes, pacing and pronunciation.



5. How do you choose music for a documentary scene?



6. Imagine the same wooden boat appears in more than 100 AI-generated shots. How would you keep the boat visually consistent?



7. How would you prevent prehistoric animals from looking anatomically wrong or obviously AI-generated?



8. Can you provide editable project files and an asset / licensing log with every finished video?



9. How long would you need to finish a 12–16 minute documentary once all instructions are provided?



10. What would your rate be per completed 12–16 minute video after the paid test?



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



We care more about your work, your answers and your attention to detail.



End your application with this exact sentence:



I understand that the paid test is 75–90 seconds and that passing the test does not guarantee ongoing work.

 case managers for outcomes, and action the 21 day follow up point without being reminded

 file on the day they arrive

Monday–Tuesday: Off



26 hours per week

30 booked cleans/month = $300 commission  

50 booked cleans/month = $500 commission

We are a fast-growing UK-based online company that has helped hundreds of members earn additional income through a unique service operating within the UK market.



We’re a small, ambitious team that values ownership, initiative and continuous improvement. Rather than hiring people to simply complete tasks, we look for people who want to make a meaningful contribution and help shape the future of the business.



This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder, take ownership of one of the company’s most important functions, and grow alongside the business as we continue to scale.



The Role



We’re looking for an excellent communicator who enjoys building relationships, writing persuasive messages and helping people take action.



Your mission is simple:



Turn interested people into members, and turn members into advocates who refer others.



You’ll own communication across our email, SMS and WhatsApp channels, ensuring every lead and every member receives timely, thoughtful and engaging communication.



This isn’t a customer support role. It’s a growth role.



You’ll play a direct part in helping the company acquire new members, improve engagement and increase referrals.

Lead Generation & Conversion



* Create and send email campaigns through Mailchimp

* Write and send SMS campaigns

Campaign Creation



* Write engaging SMS and WhatsApp copy

* Work alongside the founder to plan communication campaigns

* Brief designers on campaign assets where required

* Build and schedule campaigns in Mailchimp

* Learn our tone of voice and eventually take ownership of campaign creation



Growth



We love people who think beyond their task list.



If you notice:



* members asking similar questions

* campaigns performing exceptionally well

* opportunities to improve communication

* ideas that could generate more referrals



—we want to hear them.



You’ll have genuine input into the direction of our marketing and communication strategy.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re far more interested in attitude than experience.



You’ll probably be someone who:



* Enjoys talking to people

* Writes excellent English

* Is naturally persuasive without being pushy

* Learns quickly

* Is organised and dependable

* Takes ownership of their work

* Likes improving systems and processes

* Is proactive rather than waiting for instructions

* Wants to grow with a business over several years



Skills & Experience



Experience with all of these isn’t required, but they’re a bonus.



* Email marketing

* Copywriting

* Customer Success

* Community Management

* Sales or lead nurturing

* CRM or lifecycle marketing

* Social media community management

* Virtual Assistant experience

* Marketing Assistant experience



You should also be comfortable learning and using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude as part of your daily workflow.



Tools You’ll Use



* Mailchimp

* Kudosity SMS

* WhatsApp

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

* 

* ChatGPT

* Claude



Working With Us



You’ll work closely with the founder on a daily basis.



Initially, campaigns and messaging will be reviewed together while you learn the business, our members and our communication style. As your confidence grows, you’ll take increasing ownership of this area of the company.



We value initiative, good judgement and curiosity. If you have an idea that could improve the business, we want to hear it.



Salary & Progression



Starting salary is USD $600 per month.



This role has a clear progression path.



If you consistently generate 5 new members per month, your base salary will increase by 20%.



As you continue to consistently generate 10, 15 and 20 new members per month, additional salary increases and performance bonuses will be discussed.



The better you perform, the more responsibility and opportunity you’ll have within the business.

* Build a long-term career with a growing online business

* Work directly with a founder

* Take ownership instead of simply following instructions

* Have a measurable impact on business growth

* Grow into a larger leadership role as the company expands



If you’re someone who enjoys communicating with people, solving problems and helping a business grow, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Team Lead – Research & Communications
description:
We are a digital media company running a portfolio of media channels. A remote team, content pipelines, and ongoing correspondence with US agencies that supply the source material our content is built on. The content is high-production.



We're looking for someone with strong experience handling difficult escalations, researching unfamiliar problems, and finding solutions independently.



The ideal person has worked in a role where complicated issues eventually landed on their desk because the normal process wasn't enough. You are expected to investigate what was happening, work through incomplete or conflicting information, figure out your options, and come back with a solution without needing a supervisor to tell you every next step.



This could come from experience in senior customer escalations, case management, investigations, claims, disputes, legal support, compliance, research-heavy operations, or another environment where you regularly had to solve problems on your own.



This is not a generic Virtual Assistant position. If most of your senior-level experience has been calendar management, inbox management, scheduling, routine administrative work, or coordinating tasks for executives, this won’t be the right fit.



### What we're looking for



We want someone who is comfortable being the person a difficult problem gets handed to.



When something doesn't fit neatly into the normal process, your first instinct shouldn't be to immediately ask a supervisor what to do. We expect you to investigate the issue, use the resources available to you, understand the problem, and work toward a solution.



That can mean:



- Researching an unfamiliar rule, policy, law, or process

- Using Claude, Google, and other resources to work through complicated questions

- Looking at information from multiple sources and figuring out what matters

- Writing a strong response after researching an issue

- Finding alternatives when the obvious solution is too expensive or impractical

- Figuring out how something can be narrowed or adjusted without losing what we actually need

- Working through cases where the information is incomplete, unclear, or doesn't fit neatly into an SOP

- Taking over issues that someone else has already tried to solve and figuring out what should happen next



The core trait we're looking for is a mix of resourcefulness + problem-solving.



We want someone who doesn't get intimidated when a straightforward task turns into a messy one. Someone who is willing to dig into the details, do the grunt work, research what they don't know, and keep working the problem until they understand it.



### How the role starts



You will start by learning the normal day-to-day work of the team and handling cases yourself.



This is intentional.



To eventually solve difficult tickets for other people, you need firsthand experience with the work they're doing. You need to understand the processes, communications, records, common problems, and where things tend to get stuck.



The goal is not to keep the right person doing routine work indefinitely.



We're specifically looking for someone who can absorb the process quickly and develop into a ticket solver / lead who can take over the more difficult issues the rest of the team can't resolve independently.



That progression will depend on your ability to demonstrate that you can learn quickly, retain what you learn, research independently, make good judgment calls, and consistently find solutions.



### You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have previously owned difficult escalations or complex cases

- Have been trusted to solve problems without immediately involving a supervisor

- Learn new systems and processes quickly

- Retain what you learn and apply it to new situations

- Are comfortable researching things you've never encountered before

- Can work through a problem even when there isn't a clear SOP for it

- Know how to use AI tools as part of your research without blindly accepting their answers

- Can read through a lot of information and identify what's relevant

- Communicate clearly and can write a strong, well-researched response

- Are comfortable making reasonable judgment calls once you've gathered enough information

- Aren't afraid of tedious research or grunt work

- Want to become genuinely excellent at a specialized type of work



We care much less about your job title than what you were actually responsible for.



## Compensation



- Base compensation of **$1,100-$1,600 USD per month for 160 hours**

- Final offer will depend on experience, communication skills, and overall fit

- Performance bonuses may be awarded when agreed milestones and performance targets are met



### HOW TO APPLY



Please send your application to 
 with the subject line “Doventra Senior Escalations Specialist - Your Full Name"



Include:



1. Your full name

2. Your earliest possible full-time start date

3. Your written English rating from 1-10 (please don’t put 10 if you heavily rely on AI to write EVERYTHING for you)

4. Your spoken English rating from 1-10

5. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile (your profile must show your DISC, IQ, and English test scores, ID proof of at least 80)

6. A link to your LinkedIn profile

7. A link to your
 profile

8. Confirmation that you can commit exclusively to this role and will not work with other full-time or part-time clients or employers while employed with us (this is a full-time, long-term position. We use time tracking and require team members to work exclusively with us during their scheduled working hours).

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable using Hubstaff

10. Confirmation that you are willing to sign an NDA and complete identity verification



Then answer the questions below:



**1. Tell us about one of the most difficult problems or escalations you personally owned in a previous job.**



Choose an example where there wasn't an obvious answer and you couldn't simply follow the usual process.



What was the problem? What did you personally investigate or try? How did you d
 what to do? What was the final result? Explain in detail.



**2. You're given a task that normally has a straightforward process, but halfway through you realize the usual process won't work in this particular situation. You've never encountered the issue before and your manager is unavailable.**



Walk us through what you would do next.



Be specific about what you would investigate, what resources you would use, and how you would d
 whether you had enough information to move forward.



**3. An agency tells you that fulfilling a request will cost more than the usual range because the request is too broad. Paying the full amount is not a reasonable option, but we still need useful records from the request. You don't yet know exactly what is driving the cost.**



Walk us through what you would do next.



Be specific about what you would investigate, what questions you would ask, what alternatives you would consider, and how you would d
 whether the request could be narrowed without losing what we actually need.



**4. Someone gives you a reason why something cannot be done and refers to a rule, policy, or requirement you've never encountered before. You're not sure whether their interpretation is correct.**



You have access to Google, Claude, and other research tools.



Walk us through how you would research the issue, determine whether the explanation is correct, and d
 what to do next.



**5. When you run into a problem you genuinely cannot solve, how do you d
 that it's time to involve your manager?**



What would you want to have already done before bringing the problem to them?



Please answer every question yourself. We care much more about seeing how you think, research, and work through difficult situations than receiving perfectly polished answers. Generic or heavily AI-written answers will be rejected.

title: Podcast Editor
description:
Podcast Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve)



Position: Freelance / Part-Time

Project Type: Long-form podcast editing

Software Required: DaVinci Resolve Studio (Paid Version)



About the Role



We’re looking for a detail-oriented podcast video editor to edit long-form podcast episodes ranging from 30 minutes to 1 hour. The primary responsibility is to create clean, natural, and seamless edits by switching between camera angles, removing unnecessary pauses and filler words, and maintaining a smooth conversational flow.



The footage will already be color graded, so this role focuses primarily on editing, pacing, and making cuts look as natural as possible.



Responsibilities



* Review and organize raw podcast footage before editing.

* Switch between camera angles based on who is speaking and the natural flow of the conversation.

* Remove unnecessary filler words, such as “um” and “uh,” along with stutters, awkward pauses, repeated words, and verbal mistakes when appropriate.

* Use DaVinci Resolve Studio’s 'Smooth Cut' transition to make dialogue edits look as seamless and natural as possible.

* Ensure cuts and transitions look clean, avoiding distracting jumps, visual distortions, or unnatural movements.

* Maintain natural pacing without making the conversation feel rushed or choppy.

* Sync camera footage and audio when necessary.

* Perform basic audio-level adjustments if needed.

* Review the final edit to catch awkward cuts, missed edits, and inconsistencies before delivery.



Requirements



* Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve Studio, including familiarity with the Smooth Cut transition.

* A strong eye for detail, especially when making cuts between camera angles and removing dialogue.

* A good understanding of conversational pacing and continuity editing.

* Strong English comprehension to accurately understand conversations, identify filler words, and recognize stutters or verbal mistakes.

* Ability to make dialogue edits look natural and nearly invisible.

* Reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines.

* Ability to work independently and follow editing instructions.



What You Won’t Need to Do



* Heavy color grading — footage will already be color graded.

* Advanced sound design or extensive audio mixing.

* Complex motion graphics or elaborate visual effects.

* Unnecessary effects or transitions that distract from the conversation.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who understands that good podcast editing is often invisible. The goal is to create a polished, natural conversation where viewers can focus on what is being said without noticing the cuts.



You should be able to recognize when a cut looks awkward, know when to switch camera angles, and use Smooth Cut effectively to preserve continuity when removing unwanted dialogue.



How to Apply



Please provide:



* A link to your portfolio or examples of podcast episodes you have edited.

* Confirmation that you have DaVinci Resolve Studio (the paid version).

* A brief description of your experience with multicamera editing and dialogue cleanup.

* Your rate per episode or your expected rate for editing a 60-minute podcast.



Applicants with strong attention to detail, good communication, and a focus on clean, seamless editing are encouraged to apply.

title: [EXPERIENCED] [Female] Customer Service Rep for a fast growing female fashion dropshipping store
description:
Hi there, nice to see our vacancy has caught your attention. 



We are currently operating 3 fashion dropshipping stores focussed solely on women in the US. As all 3 stores are beginning to scale, we are looking for our first FEMALE dedicated Customer Service Representative on a full time basis to help answer customers questions, resolve order problems, and de-escalate cases of unhappy customers into neutral / happy customers. 



We have the templates and videos on how we solve customer issues, but we need your skill of common sense, empathy and problem solving to adjust these templates to the customers problem and send a solid, empathetic, but fact based response to our customers. This all has the goal of turning an unhappy customer into a happy one while protecting the companies profits. A problem solving, de-escalating, solution driven mindset is your main skill needed for this role.



How a typical day looks:



You start your morning by opening ReAmaze and quickly scanning the inbox for urgent cases that need immediate attention. Since our supplier is fully active during these hours, this is the best time to resolve order-related issues.



You also check our logistics Slack channel for any delivery issues reported by our supplier. For example, a package may have failed delivery because the customer's address is incorrect or the courier needs an access code. You check the order details and contact the customer to request the missing information so our supplier can arrange redelivery as quickly as possible.



You notice a customer received the wrong size and has already provided a photo confirming it. You head to the appropriate Slack channel, tag our supplier account manager, and provide all necessary order information so the issue can be resolved quickly.



Next, you find an
 from a customer who received a damaged item but didn't attach any photos. You select the appropriate response template, adjust it to the customer's situation, and request the necessary evidence.



Once the urgent cases are handled, you focus on return requests. You read each request, assess the situation and level of escalation, and choose the appropriate response or template.



You then move on to more difficult or unhappy customers. For example, yesterday you sent a customer our initial return instructions. Today, she replies that the solution is unacceptable and demands a full refund without returning the item to our return warehouse in China.



You assess the situation, respond with empathy while clearly explaining the applicable policy, and d
 that some flexibility may help resolve the issue. Instead of the initial 10% keep-the-item refund, you may offer 25% while allowing her to keep the item. The goal is to find a reasonable solution while protecting both the customer experience and the business's profits.

title: Part-Time Video Editor — Executive Interviews
description:
Digital Transformations AI is hiring a dependable video editor to join our production team remotely. You will work directly with our team on professional interview content for websites, YouTube, LinkedIn,
, and Instagram.



Our first assignment is a 1-hour, 41-minute recorded interview with a senior real estate executive. Additional interview sessions are planned over the next few months.



We want clean, credible editing: natural pacing, clear dialogue, accurate English captions, and simple branded graphics. The style should feel like a professionally produced business interview, without frequent zoom effects, emojis, sound effects, or flashing captions.



PAY AND HOURS



• $4–$5 USD per hour, based on experience and the paid assessment.

• Up to 20 hours per week.

• All work hours are paid, including onboarding, editing, revisions, and corrections.

• Performance and rate review after 30 days.

• Payment schedule and time-tracking arrangements will be agreed in writing before work begins.



FIRST ASSIGNMENT



The first interview will produce 29 video exports:



• Six long-form videos in 16:9, approximately 5–12 minutes each; one may run up to 15 minutes.

• One personal introduction in 16:9, approximately 60–90 seconds.

• One audience invitation, approximately 30–60 seconds, exported in both 16:9 and 9:16.

• Twenty vertical clips in 9:16, approximately 45–90 seconds each, with burned-in captions.

• An SRT caption file for every export.

• Organized, editable project files and reusable graphics.



We provide a selects sheet with timecodes and titles, a transcript, a name list, and brand assets. Suggestions for additional strong interview moments are welcome.



EDITING RESPONSIBILITIES



• Remove the interviewer’s questions where the speaker’s answer can stand alone. We will provide wording for a simple text card when context is needed.

• Remove false starts, repeated takes, setup chatter, and unnecessary pauses while keeping the speaker’s delivery natural.

• Preserve the speaker’s meaning, numbers, and qualifications. Flag any edit that could change the meaning.

• Reduce background noise and room sound without creating robotic audio artifacts.

• Level dialogue consistently, targeting approximately -14 LUFS integrated for final exports.

• Create accurate, synchronized captions in sentence case, using one or two readable lines.

• Build and reuse a lower third, title card, end card, and vertical layout from our brand kit.

• Keep captions and other on-screen text editable so our team can prepare Spanish versions later.

• Follow our file naming and folder structure.



No stock footage or stock music is required.



ABOUT THE FOOTAGE



The source is a 640 × 360 Zoom recording. We understand its limitations and do not expect artificial detail or perfect HD quality.



For vertical clips, use a considered layout that places the landscape video within a branded vertical frame, with space for a headline and captions. Avoid enlarging the footage into a heavily cropped, pixelated full-screen image.



Use restrained sharpening and natural color correction. We will confirm the available audio tracks before the paid assessment.



INITIAL PRODUCTION TARGETS



At approximately 20 hours per week:



• Week 1: Create templates, assemble a cleaned interview timeline, and deliver the first long-form video and three shorts for style approval.

• Week 2: Complete the remaining five long-form videos, introduction, and invitation exports.

• Week 3: Complete the remaining 17 shorts, caption files, and project handoff.



We will review these targets together after assessing the footage. Please communicate early if a deadline needs adjustment.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Experience editing long-form interviews or podcasts.

• Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro.

• Dialogue cleanup and audio leveling.

• Strong English listening and reading skills.

• Accurate captioning, including names and numbers.

• Experience adapting landscape footage for vertical formats.

• Organized project files that another editor can open and continue.

• Reliable communication and replies within one business day.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply and start your message with “Guadalajara.”



Please answer these four questions:



1. Share one interview or podcast edit you completed that is at least five minutes long, plus three vertical clips you created from landscape footage. Explain your role in the editing.

2. How would you create a professional 9:16 short from a 640 × 360 landscape Zoom recording?

3. Which editing software do you use, and how do you organize project files for handoff to another editor?

4. Can you commit to 20 hours per week for the first three weeks? Include your time zone, availability, and earliest start date.



Please use specific examples from your own work. Only share portfolio material you have permission to share.



PAID ASSESSMENT



Three shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing assessment using an eight-minute interview excerpt and transcript.



Deliverables:



• One 2–3-minute landscape edit with the interviewer removed, false starts cleaned, and dialogue leveled.

• One captioned vertical clip of approximately 45–75 seconds.

• One sentence explaining why you selected that moment.



The target turnaround is 48 hours from the agreed start time. Each participant is paid regardless of the hiring decision.



The footage is confidential. Do not publish or share it. Delete the supplied footage and working copies after the assessment once we confirm receipt.



FEEDBACK AND FILE HANDOFF



We provide one consolidated list of timecoded feedback per batch and aim to review submissions within two business days. Revisions and corrections are paid work.



Save source media, project files, templates, exports, captions, and graphics in clearly organized folders in our shared workspace. Keep media relinkable and captions editable.



A confidentiality agreement will be required before access to the full interview materials.

title: Auto Loan Underwriting Assistant
description:
About Us

American Lending Finance is a U.S. auto finance company based in Michigan. We work with subprime borrowers: customers who can't get conventional financing and need a lender who understands their situation. We get loan applications from a select group of partner dealerships.



Position Summary

We're looking for a detail-oriented Underwriting Assistant who takes loan applications from the moment they arrive to the moment they're booked. You'll enter and verify applications, apply our underwriting guidelines, talk with dealers, customers, and employers, and make sure every file is complete before it's funded.



Key Responsibilities



Application Processing & Underwriting



Receive credit applications from our partner dealers and enter them into our loan system accurately

Review credit reports and scoring, and check each application against our guidelines, including Loan-to-Value (LTV), Payment-to-Income (PTI), and Debt-to-Income (DTI)

Make or recommend a credit decision based on our underwriting policy

Structure and confirm payment arrangements that fit the customer's budget



Verification



Call customers to verify identity, residence, income, and loan terms

Call employers to verify employment and income

Call dealers to confirm deal details, vehicle information, and stipulations

Spot inconsistencies or red flags and escalate them to the lead underwriter



Documentation & Booking



Prepare loan documents and go over the terms with the customer

Collect and track all required documents and stipulations from dealers and customers

Book approved loans and make sure each file is complete and ready to fund



Portfolio Analysis (between applications)



Review recently charged-off accounts to find patterns in borrower behavior, deal structure, and early warning signs

Share what you find so we can keep improving our underwriting decisions



Requirements



Excellent, fluent spoken and written English. You'll be on the phone every day with U.S. customers, dealers, and employers

Experience in auto loan underwriting, loan processing, KYC, or customer verification (subprime auto experience is a strong plus)

Understanding of LTV, PTI, DTI, and credit report basics

Able to understand what a customer needs and explain loan terms clearly and professionally

Strong attention to detail and the discipline to follow guidelines consistently

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work area, and a good headset



Schedule



Full-time, minimum 40 hours per week

We're open 6 days a week, 8:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern Time

Shifts are either 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET or 11:00 AM–7:00 PM ET. That's currently 8:00 PM–5:00 AM or 11:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine time, and one hour later during U.S. winter months

title: CRO Specialist / Growth Designer (A/B Testing)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce group and are hiring one person to own our conversion program: build product pages, landing pages, and offers, A/B test them, read the data, and ship the winners, every week. You will work directly with the founders, our media buyer, and our ad creative team. We have enough traffic to run several real tests every month, so you will see results fast. 



This is not a "make it look pretty" job. We care about revenue per visitor.



What You Will Do:

Build pages and funnels:

- Design product pages, advertorials / pre-landers, listicles, bundle pages, and upsell / cross-sell flows

- Build landing pages that match the ad angles that are scaling 

- Set up post-purchase upsells, the cart drawer, and checkout settings

- Keep a library of proven page templates and sections



Design and test offers:

- Test bundles, tiered pricing, quantity breaks, free-gift and free-shipping thresholds, and discount framing

- Run price and offer tests

- Calculate the margin impact before any offer goes live, no offer ships without a profit-per-order calculation



Run A/B tests:

- Keep a prioritized test backlog (hypothesis, expected impact, effort)

- Launch multiple tests per week, each with a written hypothesis and a clear success metric

- Calculate sample size before launch and run tests to statistical significance

- Keep a test log: what changed, dates, traffic, result, decision, learning

- Roll out winners everywhere they apply; document losers so we never re-test them



Analyze:

- Weekly review Shopify analytics: funnel drop-off by step, device, traffic source, landing page

- Review heatmaps and session recordings to find friction

- Mine customer support tickets, reviews, and surveys for objections and copy angles

- Monthly competitor check (pages and offers)



Report: 

- Weekly report: tests running, tests finished, results, next launches, RPV / CVR / AOV trend

- Monthly report: total lift, learnings, next month's backlog, recommendations for ads and creative

- Tell the media buyer which landers get traffic and at what split; feed winning hooks and objections back to the creative team

- You can explain sample size and statistical significance in simple words

- Good understanding of direct-response basics: hook, proof, objections, urgency

- Strong written English; clear, short reports

- Reliable internet, a good computer, and a quiet workspace

- Shopify Liquid / theme development knowledge



What We Offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Salary depending on experience, with room for increases based on results

- Real traffic, real budget, and real ownership of the test program

- Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Room to grow as the team grows



How to Apply:

1) Send your CV

2) 3 to 5 A/B tests you have run, at least one that LOST. For each test, include:

- Context: niche, page type, and rough traffic (sessions/day or orders/day)

- What data gave you the idea (heatmap, drop-off, survey, reviews, tickets)

- Your hypothesis in one sentence

- What you changed (control vs. variant, screenshots or a Loom are welcome as support)

- Tool used, traffic split, how long it ran, and sample size

- Result: CVR / RPV / AOV before and after, and whether it reached significance

- Decision: rolled out, killed, or iterated, and what you learned

You can hide brand names for NDA reasons. Relative numbers (for example "+11% RPV") are required.
