title: Experienced Senior Project Manager (Amazon FBA | Full-Time)
description:
# Join a Fast-Growing E-Commerce Brand Based in Singapore



We’re a fast-growing Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand looking for a highly capable **Amazon E-Commerce Director / Senior Project Manager** to help us scale.



This is not a coordinator role.



We’re looking for someone who can **see the big picture while being highly meticulous with the details**. You should be comfortable managing people, analysing data, improving systems, identifying problems early, and taking ownership of execution.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll oversee a team of around 6 people across listings, design, and operations.



You’ll manage product launches and Amazon projects from planning through execution.



You’ll review sales, profitability, advertising, inventory, conversion, rankings, and other key data to identify opportunities and risks.



You’ll coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, inspection agents, inventory planning, production, and shipping.



You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.



You’ll maintain accurate dashboards and reporting so management always has a clear view of the business.



You’ll identify bottlenecks and recurring problems, then improve the systems behind them rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues.



## We Want Someone Data-Driven



You should naturally ask questions like:



Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see a problem, raise it.



If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.



## Tools You’ll Use



Amazon Seller Central

Google Sheets and Docs

Notion

Helium 10

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For



At least **5 years of relevant experience**, ideally in Amazon FBA or e-commerce operations.



Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours



Monday to Friday

12 PM to 10 PM Singapore time

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and why you’re a good fit.



Clear details of your Amazon FBA experience.



Your most recent role and what you personally owned.



Examples or references to Amazon brands or projects you have worked on.



Examples of teams or projects you have managed.



A short video introduction if possible.



Please also tell us about **one Amazon or e-commerce problem you identified through data, what you discovered, and what action you took.**



## Important



Only candidates with genuine Amazon FBA experience will be considered.



This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

title: SEO & SEM Specialist
description:
SEO & SEM Specialist



Location: Remote, working with a Singapore-based team 



Employment type: Full-time, 44 hours per week / 176 hours per month 



Working hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 9:00pm Singapore time 



Reporting to: Senior SEO Manager and CEO 



Experience required: 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience. Singapore education, tuition or local-service experience is strongly preferred.



About Achievers Dream

- Achievers Dream is a Singapore Chemistry and Science tuition specialist. The centre supports Primary Science students and students taking O-Level, IP and JC H1/H2 Chemistry, with centres at Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan. Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

- Clear monthly reporting with recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.



Application process



Before submitting your resume, please include a concise 90-day draft plan for how you would improve Achievers Dream's SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads performance. This can be a one- to two-page document. We are looking for clear priorities, practical actions and how you would measure progress, not a generic proposal.



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. Your 90-day draft plan, submitted together with your resume.

3. A short summary of one SEO project and one Google Ads project you personally improved.

4. A sample dashboard, report or case study, with sensitive client data removed.

5. A short response to this question: How would you approach improving qualified trial bookings for a Singapore Primary Science and Chemistry tuition centre in your first 90 days?



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment based on an anonymised Achievers Dream landing page or Google Ads account scenario.

title: Azure APIM Developer

APIM policies and policy expressions

Exposure to:

Heavy exposure to modern Azure, API, integration, and automation projects.

A delivery culture that values technical credibility and practical engineering.

Remote-first setup with strong exposure to Australian enterprise and government clients.

title: Shopify Developer: Build a Custom Checkout Connected to Slash Payments (Fixed Price Project)
description:
PLEASE READ TO THE END. Applications that do not start with the password word will not be read.



ABOUT US

Fitmo (
) is a direct-to-consumer wellness brand: the Tetra smart bracelet, the Vitro smart band and the Soma smart scale. The store runs on Shopify and most of our customers are in the United States.



THE PROJECT

We are moving part of our US card payments from Shopify Payments to Slash Payments, the new payment processing product from Slash (
). Slash does not provide a hosted checkout, a payment link or a Shopify app. It provides an API (payment intents, refunds, webhooks) and a React payment form (npm 
 Payments runs on Whop's payment infrastructure. The product is new and in beta, so part of the job is to check with Slash's docs and support what our account supports before building.



So we need a developer to build and connect a fully custom checkout from A to Z. When a US customer clicks the main "Checkout" button on our Shopify store, they land on our own checkout page at 
, pay through Slash, and the paid order is created in Shopify automatically, like any normal Shopify order.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

- A checkout web app (React or Next.js, hosted on our Vercel account) at 
: contact, shipping address, shipping method, discount code, order summary, and payment through Slash by card, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay if Slash enables them on our account.

- A split cart for US visitors with a USD cart: one big main "Checkout" button that goes to the new Slash checkout, and right under it two smaller buttons, Shop Pay and PayPal, that open the native Shopify checkout express flows, so these customers keep their one-click payment and pay in 4. Every other visitor and currency stays on the normal Shopify checkout.

- The same rule on every checkout entry point of our theme (cart drawer, cart page, Buy it now buttons, checkout links in the theme).

- Server-side pricing from Shopify: products, discount codes, automatic discounts, bundles, shipping rates and US sales tax. Prices sent by the browser are never trusted.

- Creation of the order in Shopify after a successful Slash payment, with idempotency (never a duplicate order) and a reconciliation job (never a lost paid order).

- Refunds: a refund made in the Shopify admin is executed in Slash.

- Tracking: Meta Pixel plus Conversions API with event_id deduplication (exactly one Purchase per order), a Klaviyo Started Checkout event, UTM parameters saved on every order, and which cart button was clicked (main, Shop Pay or PayPal).

- A confirmation page, an order bump before payment, and the standard Shopify order confirmation
.

- A rollback switch that sends every cart back to the Shopify checkout in one click, plus an A/B split to send only part of the traffic to the new checkout.

- Tests in every market (US, UK, Canada, Europe), on iPhone and desktop, and a short written handover: how to run it, how to roll back, how to replay an order.



A full technical brief is ready and will be sent to shortlisted candidates.



MUST HAVE

- You have already built an external checkout for a Shopify store that went live. A theme customization does not count.

- Shopify Admin GraphQL API: order creation, including draft orders (draftOrderCalculate, draftOrderComplete) and orderCreate.

- Integration of a payment API: payment intents, webhooks with signature checks, idempotency keys, refunds. Experience with Stripe, Whop, Adyen or NMI counts.

- Apple Pay and Google Pay domain verification on a subdomain.

- Meta Pixel plus Conversions API with event_id deduplication.

- React or Next.js, Node.js, a database (Postgres or similar), deployment on Vercel.

- Clear written English and a short progress update every working day.



NICE TO HAVE

Whop Elements, the Klaviyo API, Shopify Markets and multi-currency, Shopify accelerated checkout buttons, previous work with CrispCheckout, Lasso or Checkout Champ.



HOW TO APPLY

Write the word VITRO at the very top of your application. Then answer these 6 points:

1. Links to external checkouts you built for Shopify stores (live URL or a screen recording), and the payment processor each one used.

2. How would you create the Shopify order after payment, and how do you guarantee that no paid order is ever lost or created twice?

3. How do you make sure Meta counts exactly one Purchase per order when the Pixel and the Conversions API both send it?

4. How would you handle discount codes, automatic discounts, shipping rates and US sales tax outside the Shopify checkout?

5. Your fixed price for the whole scope, what it includes, and your timeline in days.

6. Your availability in hours per week and your usual working hours (we work on Paris time).



BUDGET AND PAYMENT

- Fixed price for the whole project. Our budget is 200 to 600 USD. Quote your own price. If your quote is higher, explain what it covers.

- We pay per project, in two milestones (the split between them is agreed before the start): first when the checkout works end to end on the test setup with real orders created in Shopify, then after go-live and 7 days with every paid order present in Shopify.

- Bug fixes during the 14 days after go-live are included in the price.

- Later changes and new features are paid separately, per request, at a price agreed before the work starts. We are looking for a developer we can come back to.

- We own the code, the repository and every account used for the project.

title: Performance Graphic Designer — DTC Supplement Static Ads | Winning Ads = Performance Bonuses
description:

- IM8

- AG1

- Menerals

- Happy Mammoth

- Rosabella

WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



- Meta/Facebook static ads

- Product-focused ads

- Comparison / us-vs-them creatives

- Testimonials and social proof

- Benefit and ingredient breakdowns

- Offer-focused creatives

- Photos and existing creatives

- Creative briefs / concepts

- Tools such as Higgsfield



3D/rendering experience is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable working with existing Blender product files and creating or improving polished product renders.



AI image generation is completely fine as an ASSISTIVE tool, but we are not looking for someone who simply generates an AI image and adds text on top.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven DTC/e-commerce static ad experience

- Supplement / health & wellness experience strongly preferred

- Strong typography, composition, hierarchy, and direct-response design

- Ability to work from creative briefs and references

- Ability to produce premium product imagery and renders

- 24-hour turnaround on assigned creatives

- Extremely dependable and responsive



Proficiency in one or more of the following:



- Figma

- Adobe Photoshop

- Canva Pro



Blender / 3D rendering experience is a major advantage.



COMPENSATION



$20 per approved static creative.



Target: approximately 50 creatives per month = $1,000/month.



WINNING CREATIVE BONUSES - Read This



If one of your static ads becomes a winner, you get paid additional performance bonuses.



We want the designer financially rewarded when their work performs.



Strong designers can potentially earn an additional $500-$1,000+ per month in winner bonuses, meaning this role can grow into approximately $1,500-$2,000/month based on performance.



As the brand scales, this position can grow into a Senior Performance Designer / Creative Design Lead role with increased compensation and responsibility.

Send:



1. Your portfolio

3. Any supplement or health/wellness work

4. Examples of product renders / Blender work if available

title: Bookkeeper – MYOB Australian Experience Required
description:
Australian-Experienced MYOB Bookkeeper (Philippines) – Immediate Start



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time Ongoing | Immediate Start

PHP 300–400/hour depending on experience — higher rate considered for an exceptional candidate



We are a growing Australian digital media business looking for an experienced Philippines-based MYOB Bookkeeper to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping of our Australian company.



This is not an entry-level position.



You must have previous hands-on bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses, strong MYOB experience, and practical knowledge of Australian GST and BAS preparation.



Immediate Priority



Our bookkeeping is currently several months behind, so the first priority is to bring our MYOB accounts fully up to date.



We need someone who can start immediately and dedicate additional hours during the initial catch-up period.



Once the catch-up is complete, this will become an ongoing part-time role, expected to be approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow.



About the Business



We are an Australian digital media and content business operating multiple YouTube channels, websites, Amazon influencer/affiliate businesses and international brand partnerships.



We operate through an Australian GST-registered company and use MYOB.



Our income and expenses include:



* Australian and international brand partnerships

* Amazon and affiliate income

* AUD and USD payments

* International payment platforms

* Australian and overseas contractors and suppliers

* Normal Australian business expenses



Because of this, experience with multi-currency and online/international businesses would be particularly useful.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Bringing our existing MYOB bookkeeping fully up to date

* Ongoing bookkeeping in MYOB

* Bank and credit-card reconciliations

* Correctly categorising income and expenses

* Correct Australian GST coding

* Preparing accurate accounts and records for BAS reporting

* Reconciling AUD and foreign-currency transactions

* Recording and reconciling international brand and affiliate income

* Contractor and supplier transactions

* Receipts, invoices and supporting documentation

* Reviewing unreconciled or unusual transactions

* Identifying missing documentation and requesting what you need

* Month-end reconciliations

* Maintaining accurate, current accounts

* Liaising with our Australian accountant/BAS agent when required



REQUIRED Experience



Please apply only if you have:



* Previous professional bookkeeping experience for Australian businesses

* Strong, recent hands-on MYOB experience

* Practical Australian GST experience

* Experience preparing bookkeeping/accounts for BAS

* Bank and credit-card reconciliation experience

* Experience reviewing and correcting existing bookkeeping

* Good understanding of accounting/bookkeeping principles

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written and spoken English

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the accounts



Applicants without Australian bookkeeping + MYOB + GST/BAS experience will not be considered.



Highly Regarded



The following are advantageous but not mandatory:



* Xero Advisor Certification

* Accounting or bookkeeping qualification

* Bachelor of Accounting/Accountancy or similar

* Experience working with Australian accountants or BAS agents

* Multi-currency bookkeeping

* AUD/USD transactions

* Wise, PayPal or Stripe reconciliation

* Amazon or affiliate income

* E-commerce, digital media or online-business experience



What We Want



We are looking for someone who understands the accounts rather than simply entering transactions.



If something does not reconcile, investigate it.



If something appears to have been coded incorrectly, flag it.



If information or documentation is missing, ask for it.



If you are uncertain about the GST treatment of a transaction, do not guess.



We want someone reliable who can take ownership of the bookkeeping and keep it current going forward.



For the right person, this is intended to be a stable, long-term role.



Pay



PHP 300–400 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



We will consider a higher rate for an exceptional candidate with extensive Australian MYOB, GST and bookkeeping experience.



Additional hours will be available initially while the bookkeeping is brought up to date.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



XERO AUSTRALIA



Please send your CV/resume and answer these 7 questions:



1. How many years have you worked as a bookkeeper for Australian businesses?

title: Microsoft Fabric and Databricks Developer
description:
Microsoft Fabric & Databricks Developer

Location: Cebu or Manila, Philippines (Remote-first, aligned to Australian business hours – AEST)

Employment Type: Project Based



The Role

The Microsoft Fabric & Databricks Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Databricks. You will work within an Agile team to build and optimise data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, data transformations, and analytics solutions, ensuring reliable, secure, and cost-effective delivery that meets client requirements.



Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable data solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Databricks.

Build, configure, and optimise ETL/ELT data pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and load data from multiple sources.

Develop and maintain Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Databricks components, including tables, data models, notebooks, and data processing workflows.

Develop data transformations and processing logic using SQL, Python, PySpark, and Spark.

Integrate data from multiple sources and systems while maintaining data consistency across environments.

Monitor data pipelines and jobs, investigate failures, troubleshoot issues, and implement fixes or enhancements.

Implement data validation, error handling, monitoring, and data quality checks to ensure reliable datasets.

Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and transformations.

Optimise pipelines, queries, notebooks, and Spark jobs to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Develop and maintain CI/CD processes, version control, environment promotion, and production deployment workflows.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, analysts, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, estimate development tasks, participate in code reviews, and deliver features.



What We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in data engineering or data development roles.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks in production or enterprise environments.

Strong practical understanding of:

Data engineering and ETL/ELT pipelines

Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse

Databricks and Apache Spark

SQL, Python, and PySpark

Data transformation and integration

Experience developing and supporting scalable data pipelines and processing workflows.

Experience working with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.

Understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring, and error handling.

Hands-on experience troubleshooting and supporting production data solutions.



Project & Delivery Skills

Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, Jira (or equivalent), and modern development workflows.

Experience with CI/CD, version control, and automated deployment processes.

Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams while remaining accountable for outcomes.

Strong debugging, performance optimisation, and problem-solving capability.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

Exposure to:

Data governance and security

Cloud cost optimisation

Enterprise-scale data platforms

Prior experience working with Australian or international clients.



Why Join C9

title: Company Controller | US Construction, Job Costing & WIP
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Company Controller to serve as the senior accounting lead for an established Hawaii-based multi-trade contractor supporting commercial and institutional facilities.



The company provides roofing, HVAC/R, commercial doors, electrical, plumbing, and general maintenance services. The Controller will own the financial books, job-cost integrity, month-end close, and management reporting while partnering closely with company leadership and operations.



This is not a routine bookkeeping or data-entry role. The successful candidate must be capable of independently overseeing the company’s complete accounting function and turning operational activity, including work orders, vendor bills, payroll, subcontractor costs, and customer billings, into accurate financial information leadership can trust.



The position is fully remote and open to qualified Philippines-based professionals under an independent-contractor arrangement.



Key Responsibilities



*Financial Accounting and Close

Own the full accounting cycle from transaction coding through month-end and year-end close

Maintain the general ledger, chart of accounts, and accounting policies

Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities according to an established calendar

Prepare accurate trial balances and financial statements

Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, WIP, retainage, fixed assets, and other balance-sheet accounts

Prepare and review journal entries and investigate unusual variances before reports are released

Coordinate with external CPAs, tax advisers, auditors, and other accounting professionals as needed

Maintain accounting practices consistent with US GAAP or other company-adopted standards



*Job Costing, WIP and Project Financials

Maintain accurate job-cost records for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, overhead, and other direct costs

Prepare and review work-in-progress schedules

Identify underbilling, overbilling, cost overruns, missing costs, billing gaps, and potential margin risks

Ensure job costs and WIP accurately reflect the operational status of each work order or project

Partner with operations, project managers, and administration to ensure completed work, approved quotes, NTEs, customer invoices, and applicable revenue-recognition practices remain aligned

Provide actual-versus-estimate and gross-margin analysis for active and completed jobs

Communicate financial risks and discrepancies to leadership promptly



*Accounts Receivable and Billing Oversight

Oversee customer invoicing workflows to ensure completed work is billed promptly and accurately

Monitor accounts-receivable aging and coordinate follow-up on past-due balances

Reconcile customer deposits, progress billings, retainage, credit memos, and related accounts

Work with operations and administrative teams to secure the supporting documentation required for customer billing and payment



*Accounts Payable, Vendors and Subcontractors

Oversee accounts-payable intake, coding, approval routing, and payment runs

Ensure vendor and subcontractor invoices are assigned to the correct jobs or work orders

Maintain complete vendor records, payment terms, and applicable W-9 or tax documentation

Prevent duplicate payments and assist in resolving invoice discrepancies and vendor disputes



*Cash, Banking and Working Capital

Maintain clear daily and weekly visibility of cash balances, upcoming obligations, and expected receipts

Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts and clear outstanding items promptly

Prepare or support cash-flow forecasts for company leadership

Help improve working capital through effective billing, collections, and payment timing



*Payroll Coordination and Cost Allocation

Coordinate with internal or outsourced payroll providers

Ensure labor costs are allocated to the correct jobs, departments, and general-ledger accounts

Review payroll liabilities, employer taxes, benefits accruals, and related accounts for completeness

Support appropriate labor-burden and overhead-allocation methods for job costing



*Reporting, Controls and Systems

Prepare recurring management reports, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash position, AR/AP aging, job profitability, and WIP

Translate financial results into clear, practical recommendations for leadership

Design, document, and strengthen internal controls appropriate to the company’s size and operations

Maintain audit-ready records and documentation

Reconcile accounting systems, work-order or CMMS exports, and spreadsheet trackers

Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems, and source-data quality

Document accounting procedures to ensure continuity and consistency

Protect confidential company, financial, customer, vendor, and employee information



*Cross-Functional Partnership

Work closely with company leadership, directors, project and resource management, operations, and administration

Help operations understand job profitability, margins, cash flow, billing issues, and cost-control opportunities

Support system implementations, historical account cleanup, new entities or locations, and other special projects

Guide or train administrative staff responsible for entering bills, invoices, payroll information, or job costs



*Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Proven experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accountant in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based business

Strong knowledge of full-cycle accounting, general-ledger management, and financial reporting

Demonstrated experience independently leading month-end and year-end close

Strong job-costing and WIP experience within a project-based or work-order environment

Working knowledge of US GAAP

Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow, internal controls, and audit readiness

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Experience with QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, NetSuite, or similar accounting systems

Comfortable learning work-order, CMMS, or facilities-management platforms

Excellent written and spoken English for communication with US-based stakeholders

Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly

High level of integrity, ownership, accuracy, and professional judgment

Able to work independently and meet strict reporting and closing deadlines

Reliable internet connection, secure workspace, and appropriate remote-working equipment



*Preferred Experience

Philippine-licensed CPA, US CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification

Previous experience supporting a US-based company

Accounting experience in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based industry

Direct experience with job costing, WIP, retainage, progress billing, labor allocation, and revenue recognition

Experience working with multiple trades, departments, entities, or locations

Experience partnering directly with company owners, executives, operations leaders, or project managers

Experience supervising, reviewing, or training accounting and administrative team members



*Schedule and Work Arrangement

Full-time; exact weekly hours and schedule to be confirmed

Fully remote and open to Philippines-based candidates

Independent-contractor engagement

Must be available for scheduled collaboration with Hawaii-based leadership

Regular overlap with Hawaii Standard Time will be required for meetings, accounting questions, month-end close, billing deadlines, and other time-sensitive matters

Candidates must clearly state their availability and time zone



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

- A brief application letter introducing yourself and explaining your relevant Controller experience

- A link to your updated résumé or CV

- A summary of your experience with US accounting and US GAAP

- Details of your construction, job-costing, WIP, retainage, or project-accounting experience

- A list of the accounting, ERP, work-order, and reporting systems you have used

- Your current availability and ability to overlap with Hawaii Standard Time

- Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation in USD

- Confirmation of any active CPA license or equivalent professional accounting qualification, if applicable



Please ensure that all submitted links are accessible.


 Subject Line

CONTROLLER REPS – YOUR FULL NAME



Only complete applications that follow the instructions above will be considered.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA — U.S. Wholesale Real Estate
description:
I’m looking for a sharp, confident, organized Lead Manager / Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to join my growing U.S. real estate investment business.



This is not a general VA or administrative position. This is a sales-focused role.



Your main objective is simple:



Create qualified conversations with motivated homeowners and book qualified seller appointments on my calendar.



I handle acquisitions, property analysis, offers, negotiation, and contracts. Your responsibility is to own the seller pipeline leading up to that appointment.



What You’ll Own



1. PPL / Incoming Leads



-Contact new motivated-seller leads as quickly as possible

-Call and text new leads

-Qualify the seller and property

-Consistently follow up with leads who don’t immediately respond

-Schedule qualified appointments directly onto my calendar



Fresh inbound leads are always the highest priority.



2. SMS / Text Campaigns



-Help manage outbound SMS campaigns inside XLeads

-Monitor and respond to incoming text conversations

-Identify interested and motivated property owners

-Call promising SMS leads when appropriate

-Qualify interested sellers

-Schedule qualified appointments

-Properly manage opt-outs and lead statuses



3. Cold Calling



When there are no fresh inbound leads or priority follow-ups:

-Cold call targeted homeowner lists

-Start natural conversations with property owners

-Identify potential motivation

-Qualify interested sellers

-Schedule qualified appointments

-Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready today



Lead Management & Follow-Up



You will help own the seller database inside XLeads CRM.



Every lead should have accurate:



-Notes

-Status/stage

-Follow-up date

-Tasks

-Contact history

-Motivation

-Property condition

-Timeline

-Price expectations

-Decision-maker information

-Next action



No legitimate opportunity should disappear because someone forgot to follow up.



Priority Order



Your work should generally follow this order:



1. Fresh PPL/inbound leads

2. Hot SMS responses

3. Scheduled follow-ups

4. SMS campaign management

5. Cold calling



If a fresh motivated-seller lead comes in while you’re cold calling, you stop and work the fresh lead.



Speed-to-lead matters.



What Happens After You Book an Appointment



Once you’ve properly qualified a seller, you’ll schedule the appointment with me and leave detailed notes so I’m fully prepared.



I take over from there:



Property analysis → seller appointment → offer → negotiation → contract



Your job is to make sure I’m spending my time speaking with legitimate seller opportunities.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



* Speak excellent, natural English

* Be comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

* Have a confident and friendly phone presence

* Be comfortable making a high volume of calls

* Be able to build rapport instead of simply reading scripts

* Ask good follow-up questions

* Be persistent without being pushy

* Have strong written English for SMS conversations

* Be extremely organized

* Take excellent CRM notes

* Be coachable

* Be dependable

* Be competitive and results-driven

* Be comfortable being measured by performance



Previous experience with U.S. real estate, wholesaling, real estate investing, ISA work, lead management, cold calling, or motivated sellers is strongly preferred.



Experience with XLeads is a bonus but isn’t required.



How Performance Will Be Measured



We will track metrics such as:



* Speed-to-lead

* Calls/conversations

* Contact rate

* Follow-up completion

* Qualified seller leads

* Qualified appointments scheduled

* Appointment show rate

* CRM accuracy

* Opportunities generated

* Contracts and closed deals resulting from leads you manage



I’m not looking for someone who simply checks boxes or logs hours.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become an important part of a growing real estate business.



Schedule & Compensation



Starting schedule: Approximately 25–30 hours per week



You must have availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours so incoming leads can be contacted quickly.



Starting compensation: $4–$6 USD/hour depending on experience and ability, with the opportunity to earn additional performance bonuses from closed deals.



There is an opportunity for increased hours, compensation, and responsibility as the business grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your previous sales and/or real estate experience.

2. Any experience you’ve had with U.S. real estate investors or wholesalers.

3. Your cold-calling experience.

4. Your experience managing SMS/text campaigns.

5. CRMs you’ve previously used.

6. Your desired hourly rate.

7. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

8. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be good at speaking with motivated homeowners.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Finally, begin your application with the words:



“SELLER FIRST”



This lets me know you read the entire job posting.

title: Customer Support & Subscription Specialist - Shopify + Loop Subscriptions | DTC E-Commerce
description:
Schedule & Compensation

Monday-Friday, 10:00 AM-2:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Month 2 onward:

Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

40 hours/week at $3/hour

Approximately $520/month average



This is a long-term role. As the brand scales and you prove yourself, compensation and responsibility can increase.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing U.S.-based health & wellness supplement brand focused on nerve health.



We are looking for a highly dependable Customer Support & Subscription Specialist to own the customer-support side of the business.



We are starting from zero orders, so Month 1 begins at 20 hours/week. Beginning Month 2, the role moves to full-time coverage.



Do not let the starting pay fool you. We are building for scale and expect top performance from day one. The right person can grow with the company.



The #1 thing we care about is DEPENDABILITY.



We need someone who is patient, professional, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with American, English-speaking customers.



You should be able to solve problems without sounding robotic, defensive, or dismissive.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Customer support through
/helpdesk

-
 and Instagram comments and 

- Shopify order and customer issues

- Loop Subscriptions management

- Canceling, pausing, skipping, rescheduling, or modifying subscriptions

- Updating addresses, products, quantities, shipment dates, and payment details

- Refunds and cancellations according to company policy

- Tracking delayed, missing, or incorrectly delivered orders

- Working with our 3PL and fulfillment systems, including Logiwa

- Investigating order problems and coordinating with fulfillment when needed

- Keeping clear notes and escalating unusual issues to management

- Identifying recurring customer problems and helping improve our SOPs and support templates



LOOP SUBSCRIPTIONS IS A MAJOR PRIORITY



We currently use Loop Subscriptions.



Direct Loop experience is strongly preferred. If you have used Loop before, make that very clear in your application.



Experience with Shopify and other subscription apps such as Kaching, Recharge, or Skio is also valuable, but Loop is the platform we use.



EXPERIENCE WE WANT



- Proven e-commerce customer-support experience

- Strong Shopify experience

- Subscription-management experience; Loop strongly preferred

- Excellent written English

- Comfortable communicating with U.S. customers

- Patient and calm with frustrated customers

- Experience with 3PL, warehouse, shipping, or fulfillment systems

- Experience with helpdesk tools such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, or Help Scout

- Experience responding to
 and Instagram comments and 

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable internet and reliable attendance

- Ability to consistently work the required U.S. Pacific Time schedule

- Long-term mindset



IMPORTANT: WE ARE NOT A DROPSHIPPING BRAND



This is not a black-hat or dropshipping operation.



We are a legitimate, by-the-books U.S. brand with real inventory, professional fulfillment, proper systems, and long-term plans.



You will not spend your day apologizing for fake tracking numbers, 30-day shipping, or low-quality products.



Normal e-commerce issues still happen - delayed packages, wrong addresses, subscription questions, refunds, and missing deliveries - and your job is to calmly investigate and solve them.



Because we are a health & wellness brand, you must also know when NOT to guess.



Product or medical questions outside approved support guidance should be escalated rather than answered with improvised health claims.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



LOOP SUPPORT



Then answer all of the following:



1. How many years of e-commerce customer-support experience do you have, and which brands or types of brands have you supported?



2. What have you personally handled inside Shopify?



3. Have you personally used Loop Subscriptions? If yes, explain exactly what you did inside Loop.



4. Which other subscription platforms have you used? Examples: Recharge, Skio, Kaching.



5. Which helpdesk and 3PL/warehouse tools have you used? Examples: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, Help Scout, Logiwa.



6. SCENARIO - A customer writes:



"I canceled my subscription last month and you charged me again. This is ridiculous. Refund me immediately."



Write the exact response you would send.



7. SCENARIO - A customer's tracking says "Delivered," but they say they never received the package.



Walk us through exactly what you would check and what you would do next.



8. A customer comments publicly on Instagram:



"Does this cure neuropathy?"



Write the exact public response you would post.



9. Can you consistently work Monday-Friday, 10 AM-2 PM Pacific Time for Month 1 and then Monday-Friday, 9 AM-5 PM Pacific Time beginning Month 2?



10. Are you currently working another job or supporting other clients? If yes, what hours?



Please answer every question. Generic applications will not be considered.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Researcher - Running / Fitness Niche
description:
About the role



I'm growing a personal Instagram account in the running and fitness space — lifestyle-driven, authentic content rather than heavily produced videos.



I'm looking for someone to help me research what's working in the niche and turn my raw footage into Reels at a consistent volume.



This is two jobs in one, and I need both:



Research — you stay close to what's performing in running and fitness Reels and document it.

Editing — you take my footage and cut it into short-form Reels.



If you're strong at one and weak at the other, this probably isn't the right fit.



What you'll do

Spend focused time daily inside running and fitness content on Instagram, tracking what's performing and why.

Keep a shared research doc organized and current so we always have a running list of ideas to pull from.

Edit short-form vertical Reels from an organized library of my raw footage.

Write natural, native-sounding on-screen text. This matters a lot — a strong edit with a weak or stiff hook won't perform.

Deliver consistently at volume. This isn't one polished video a week.

Keep our tracker updated so we both know where every video stands.



You'll send me work for review, I'll approve or give notes, and we'll keep a steady loop going. Async is fine — I don't need you online at set hours, but I do need you responsive and consistent with deadlines.



What I'm looking for

Real experience editing short-form vertical video for Instagram Reels or TikTok. Portfolio required.

Fluent, natural written English — you'll be writing text that has to sound like a native speaker wrote it.

Comfort in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro. After Effects is a bonus, not a requirement.

A genuine feel for hooks, pacing, and retention. You can look at a Reel and explain why it held attention.

Organized and self-directed. Trackers and docs stay current without me chasing you.

Reliable communication. If something slips, you tell me before I have to ask.



Bonus points:



You run, or you're into fitness generally. You'll be watching this content daily — it helps if you actually enjoy it.

Experience helping grow an account from a small starting point, personal or client.

You already have a system for finding trending content and audio.



Details:



Pay based on experience. Tell me your rate. I'd rather pay well for someone genuinely good than hire cheap and redo the work.

Long-term intent. I'm looking to build something with someone over time, not fill a one-off gig.

Paid test project before any ongoing commitment, so we both know it's a fit.



How to apply:



Please include all of the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed:



Your portfolio. If you have short-form vertical edits, lead with those.

One Instagram Reel from the running or fitness niche that you think performed well, and why. Two or three sentences.

Your rate and weekly availability.

Which editing software you use.





Looking forward to seeing your work.
